metadata.title: Technical Specification Compliance Benchmark (Pair B)
metadata.description: Benchmark evaluating technical specification for equipment monitoring dashboard against general technical standard.

parent_requirements.description: Explain what the system or product is intended to do and the problem it is meant to solve for its users.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document explains what the system, product, or dashboard is intended to do.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: System intended capability and operational role.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The dashboard helps maintenance staff monitor equipment condition and identify developing problems before they interrupt daily operations.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target technical overview explicitly states that the dashboard helps maintenance staff monitor equipment condition.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document explains the problem the system solves or its operational purpose for users.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Problem solved (e.g. identifying equipment problems before failure).

expected_evidence.excerpt: identify developing problems before they interrupt daily operations.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target document explicitly explains that the system identifies developing problems before they interrupt daily operations.

parent_requirements.description: State what is included in the system, what is outside its scope, and any important operating boundaries or limits.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document states what is included in the system or identifies its main components.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The application collects readings from connected sensors, displays current status, and stores historical measurements so staff can review changes over time.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target document lists key system capabilities: sensor collection, current status display, and historical data storage.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document states what is outside system scope or boundaries (e.g. not controlling physical operation).
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Explicit scope exclusion and boundary demarcation.

expected_evidence.excerpt: does not control the equipment's physical operation.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target overview explicitly excludes physical control of the equipment from system scope.

parent_requirements.description: Describe the main actions the system performs and the expected interactions between functions.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document describes the main functional actions the application or system performs.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Primary actions (collecting readings, storing history, displaying status).

expected_evidence.excerpt: The application collects readings from connected sensors, displays current status, and stores historical measurements

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target capabilities section enumerates core functional actions performed by the application.

parent_requirements.description: Identify the users, external systems, hardware, or communication channels that exchange data with the system.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document identifies system users, user interfaces, or client applications (e.g. operators using a web browser).

expected_evidence.excerpt: Operators use a web browser to view the dashboard.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target connections section specifies operators accessing the dashboard through a web browser.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document identifies external systems, hardware, or gateways that connect to the system.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: External gateway and hardware connection identification.

expected_evidence.excerpt: Sensor readings arrive from a gateway connected to the equipment.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target connections section specifies sensor readings arriving via equipment gateway.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document specifies communication protocols or technical interface details for data exchange.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Specific communication protocol and interface definitions.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The document does not specify the communication protocol or list the full set of external software interfaces.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target explicitly disclaims communication protocol specification and external software interface list.

parent_requirements.description: Explain important hazards or failure conditions and describe how the system responds to keep people or assets safe.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document describes hazards, faults, or failure conditions and how the system detects or warns of them.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Fault detection and warning behavior (e.g. sensor loss warning).

expected_evidence.excerpt: If a sensor stops sending readings, the dashboard displays a warning and marks that sensor's status as unavailable.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Partial evidence conflict: block p1_b10 and p1_b16 provide fault detection and warning behavior, but block p1_b11 explicitly disclaims recovery steps or other hazard responses.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document explains recovery steps or automated fault recovery procedures.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Fault recovery steps and hazard response handling.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The document does not explain recovery steps or other hazard responses.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target document explicitly disclaims recovery steps and other hazard responses.

parent_requirements.description: Include at least one measurable performance or quality target that can be verified during testing.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document specifies at least one measurable numeric target, capacity limit, response-time threshold, or pass/fail criterion.

expected_evidence.excerpt: No numeric response-time target, capacity limit, or explicit acceptance threshold is provided.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target document explicitly states no numeric response-time target, capacity limit, or acceptance threshold is provided.

parent_requirements.description: Describe how the system will be checked, including test scenarios, expected outputs, or sign-off criteria.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document describes how the system is tested, verified, or validated through test scenarios.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Testing methodology and operator verification actions.

expected_evidence.excerpt: During testing, an operator will confirm that live readings appear, historical values can be opened, and a warning is shown when a sensor connection is lost.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target validation section details operator verification testing for live readings, historical data, and sensor loss warnings.
